title: Emotion Network Analysis During COVID-19 Quarantine - A Longitudinal Study
limitations: - Did not perform group classification based on gender or work status, presence of more people at home, history of mental health problems, and personality characteristics; - Potential influence of POMS dimension structure on network clustering; - High attrition when comparing baseline and longitudinal data; - Limitations in generalizability of findings.
notes: The paper does not mention preregistration or availability of code/data. The authors state that datasets are not readily available for public use and should be requested via email. The study used an online survey (Qualtrics) distributed through social networks, which may not be considered a traditional ESM/EMA device.
